page.overview:
Who is Wawkesa?

Wawkesa is a character in Final Fantasy XIV. He is the leader of a group of bandits in the outskirts of Kozama'uka.

After Wuk Lamat obtained the keystone in Earthenshire and was on his way to Yok Huy, Wawkesa, disguised, appeared saying that Rediroq had forgotten to give her something important and asked Wuk Lamat to accompany him back to the village. Wuk Lamat then left with him alone. After a long time, Wuk Lamat's companions discovered that she had never returned to Earthenshire..}} With Koana's help in investigating, they discover Wawkesa's true identity and that his gang frequently attacks merchants in the Many Fires area. Koana decided to disguise hiself as a merchant as bait for the bandits..}}

The plan worked, and Koana managed to trick Wawkesa into trying to loot it. Wawkesa quickly realized it was a trap and fled, leaving his henchmen behind. Once Koana interrogated the captured bandits, they confessed to being hired to capture Wuk Lamat, but only Wawkesa knew the details. Koana left the bandits with the Landsguard, and with Thancred's help, they followed Wawkesa's trail. They discovered that Wawkesa had been hired by one of the Hoobigo who accompanied Bakool Ja Ja..}}
